# רם נכסים חיים ענבי (Ram Nekasim Chaim Anavi)

> Real-estate brokerage in Holon, Israel — sales, rentals, and property management of apartments across Holon, Bat Yam, and Rishon LeZion. Over 24 years of local experience.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://ram-haim.co.il/): agency overview and featured listings
- [Apartments](https://ram-haim.co.il/apartments): full searchable catalog of properties for sale and rent
- [For sale](https://ram-haim.co.il/apartments?dealType=sale): apartments for sale in Holon and the central district
- [For rent](https://ram-haim.co.il/apartments?dealType=rent): apartments for rent
- [Buying an apartment](https://ram-haim.co.il/buying-apartment): the buyer process, financing, and guidance
- [Selling an apartment](https://ram-haim.co.il/selling-apartment): the seller process, legal/tax checks, valuation, and marketing
- [About](https://ram-haim.co.il/about): about the agency and its licensed brokers
- [FAQ](https://ram-haim.co.il/faq): common questions about buying, selling, and renting
- [Articles](https://ram-haim.co.il/articles): guides on mortgages, purchase tax, urban renewal in Holon, neighborhoods, valuation, and more

## Articles (guides)
- [Mortgage guide](https://ram-haim.co.il/articles/mortgage-guide): approvals, equity, rate tracks, getting better terms
- [Purchase tax guide](https://ram-haim.co.il/articles/purchase-tax-guide): mas rechisha brackets for single-home buyers and investors
- [First apartment guide](https://ram-haim.co.il/articles/first-apartment-guide): budgeting, equity, and buying a first home in Holon
- [Pre-purchase checklist](https://ram-haim.co.il/articles/pre-purchase-checklist): legal, planning, physical and financial checks before buying
- [New vs second-hand](https://ram-haim.co.il/articles/new-vs-secondhand): developer vs resale apartments, true total cost
- [Apartment pricing](https://ram-haim.co.il/articles/apartment-pricing): how to value and price an apartment correctly
- [Selling alone](https://ram-haim.co.il/articles/selling-alone): the real cost of selling without a broker
- [Home staging](https://ram-haim.co.il/articles/home-staging): low-cost prep that raises the sale price
- [Landlord guide](https://ram-haim.co.il/articles/landlord-guide): pricing, tenant screening, contracts, rental tax tracks
- [Holon neighborhoods](https://ram-haim.co.il/articles/holon-neighborhoods): where to live and invest, neighborhood by neighborhood
- [Urban renewal in Holon](https://ram-haim.co.il/articles/urban-renewal-holon): pinui-binui vs TAMA 38 and how to spot real opportunities
- [Foreign investors](https://ram-haim.co.il/articles/foreign-investors): buying and managing Israeli property from abroad

## Services
- Property sales (apartments, garden apartments, cottages, investment properties)
- Property rentals
- Property management for owners and overseas investors
- Pricing/valuation and full transaction support

## Areas served
Holon, Bat Yam, Rishon LeZion (central Israel)
